DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", xAddress as "xAddress", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.modbus_element_alarm_configs WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.modbus_element_alarm_configs (element_type_id, element_id, alarm_config_id xAddress, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId , :elementId , :alarmConfigId , :xAddress , :enabled , :visible , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.modbus_element_alarm_configs WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId AND alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId
